text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can generate art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools help people create faster and try new ideas. However, many people ask an important question: can a machine really be creative? Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI only learns from data and patterns it has seen before. It cannot feel or understand what it makes. So, perhaps the best results come when humans and AI work together. People provide the vision and meaning, while AI offers new tools and possibilities. In this way, technology supports creativity instead of replacing it.
